name: linkedin-feed-blocker
tagline: Minimal Chrome extension that removes the LinkedIn home feed
description: linkedin-feed-blocker is a minimal Chrome extension that removes the LinkedIn home feed while leaving the rest of the site fully functional. No settings, no telemetry, no UI — it simply makes the infinite scroll disappear. A tiny niche productivity tool that an awful lot of people can relate to.
highlights: Removes the LinkedIn home feed with a minimal extension
Everything else on LinkedIn keeps working
No settings, no telemetry, no bloat
Anti-scroll productivity for a very relatable niche
curatorNote: Sometimes the best productivity tool is the one that removes a feature. A one-purpose extension that kills the feed and nothing else is refreshingly disciplined.
